# GSAP

GSAP core and ScrollTrigger 3.14.2, copied unchanged from the official npm package `gsap@3.14.2`.

Package: https://www.npmjs.com/package/gsap/v/3.14.2
Source: https://github.com/greensock/GSAP/tree/3.14.2
License: https://gsap.com/standard-license/

The original copyright and license notices are retained in both files. GSAP is distributed under its standard no-charge license, not the MIT license.

The libraries are served locally so the website needs no third-party CDN request. Website-specific animations live in `../motion.js`; edit that file rather than these vendor files.
